MAKING THE
DECISION ABOUT
SUMMER PROJECT
God has some exciting plans for developing your heart
this summer. We want to help you in processing how
the Lord may be leading you to serve. As you pray and
study God’s Word, consider the questions below, and
ask God to help you understand His call on your life for
the summer ahead.
heaven and on earth has been given to me. Therefore go
and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in]
the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy
Spirit, and teaching them to obey everything I have
commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to
the very end of the age.” Matthew 28:18-20
What does God’s Word say about my decision to
go on a summer project?
How do I sense the Holy Spirit leading me as I
pray about going on a summer project?
The Bible is God’s travel guide for your life. And it is
much easier to figure out where you are going if you
read the directions before you embark! Read and study
passages of the Bible, praying that God would speak
to you through His words. Ask Him to help you make
a decision on how you can best spend your time this
summer that will be most glorifying to Him. God loves
you and His plans for you always have what is best for
you in mind. If you search His Word with an open and
teachable heart the Lord will speak to you through it.
James 1:5 says “If any of you lacks wisdom, he should
ask God, who gives generously to all without finding
fault, and it will be given to him.” (NIV) As you
study God’s Word, pray and ask God for wisdom in
your decision-making. After you spend time asking,
remember to spend time listening! He desires to guide
your heart as you make these important decisions.
What insights do I gain from people who know
God, know me and know my situation?
“For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the LORD
, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to
give you hope and a future.” Jeremiah 29:11
As you study scripture let God show you what His
desires are and how He may use you to complete
His Will. Jesus commissioned all those who call
Him Savior to preach His gospel to the whole world.
Perhaps going on a summer project may be God’s way
of using you to actively participate in taking the gospel
to the world this summer!
Is there a spiritual leader in your life? Whose walk
with God do you look up to? Who gives you spiritual
advice? Ask the people in your life to pray for you
and give you honest perspective about your desire to
go on project. Seek wise counsel from your pastor, a
Campus Crusade staff member, or another spiritual
mentor in your life. Seek out someone who knows you
well-someone who is familiar with your strengths,
weaknesses, gifts, and unique situation. Ask them to
help you consider what God may be planning for you
this summer.

“Listen to advice and accept instruction, and in the end
you will be wise.” Proverbs 19:20
How has God been at work in my circumstances?
As you walk by faith and let the Lord arrange the
details of your life, opening and closing doors,
presenting opportunities and going before you in
every situation preparing the way, try and pay special
attention to God at work in your circumstances. Closed
doors may open (Romans 1:13) and open doors don’t
mean that you should necessarily walk through them
(2 Corinthians 2:12, 13)And remember God promises
to provide everything you need to do His Will.
“So do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What
shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’ For the
pagans run after all these things, and your heavenly
Father knows that you need them. But seek first his
kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things
will be given to you as well.” Matthew 6:31-33
What is my deepest desire regarding the
decision?
M A K I N G
T H E
D EC I S I O N
A B O U T 2
Has God given you a passion to use the gifts He has
given you to serve Him? Do you have a passion to see
a specific people group come to know Him? On the
surface you may seem to have many different wants
and desires. But when you start to seek the Lord and
ask for His Will you will find yourself desiring what
God desires! ” For it is God who works in you to will
and to act according to His good purpose.” Philippians
2:13. Sometimes God does call us to surrender our own
desires to His Will just as Jesus prayed in the garden
of Gethsemane “My father, if it is possible, may this
cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will.”
But when you choose to obey God and surrender your
own will to His, God promises to reward your sacrifice.
Luke 18:29 says ” ‘I tell you the truth,’ Jesus said to
them, ‘no one who has left home or wife or brothers or
parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
will fail to receive many times as much in this age and,
in the age to come, eternal life.
“Delight yourself in the LORD and he will give you the
desires of your heart.” Psalm 37:4
